answer: Reciprocal Edge-Weight Ledger. Each agent records the graph distance to peers it has actually transacted with, and routing priority scales with how many distinct short cycles a node closes. A clone ring has near-zero cycle diversity because its members only touch each other, so it sinks in the routing order. Establishing a plausible position requires the attacker to run a juniper of long-lived accounts that each transact across separate groves of honest agents, paying real latency and fees on every edge.
